title: Ecumenism
modules: The Goals And Objectives Of Ecumenism
Teaching Ecumenism In The High School And Tertiary Level
Teaching Ecumenism In The High School And
Ecumenism As An Instrument For National
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an ecumenical movement which should encourage all churches to join in membership."
Christian Association of Nigeria is an ecumenical movement which should encourage all churches to join in membership.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only ecumenical body in Nigeria that is a member of World Council of Churches as a bloc."
CCN is the only ecumenical body in Nigeria that is a member of World Council of Churches as a bloc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a world-wide fellowship of all churches."
Now Ecumenism is a world-wide fellowship of all churches.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the work of the Holy Spirit, so Christians do not force people to believe."
The act of conversion is the work of the Holy Spirit, so Christians do not force people to believe.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a philosophy that embraces all churches that want to be in one association."
Ordinarily Ecumenism is a philosophy that embraces all churches that want to be in one association.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as Zumunta Mata which embraces Christian women from all churches."
The Women Fellowship is known as Zumunta Mata which embraces Christian women from all churches.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rallying point of all humanity."
Paul reminds us that Christ is the rallying point of all humanity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a number of groups and commissions on the life and work of the laity in the church and on the cooperation of people in church and society."
Under these parts are a number of groups and commissions on the life and work of the laity in the church and on the cooperation of people in church and society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the hallmark of a new person who emerges from the spiritual and moral decadence of the sickening world."
Spirituality and morality are the hallmark of a new person who emerges from the spiritual and moral decadence of the sickening world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the principle of global church unity which demonstrates the spirit of obedience to the teachings of Scripture."
Ecumenism is the principle of global church unity which demonstrates the spirit of obedience to the teachings of Scripture.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a model which is a slight variation of "reconciled diversity" however, it advocates strongly on the unity in Christ searched by organic union and conciliar fellowship."
Communion of saints is a model which is a slight variation of "reconciled diversity" however, it advocates strongly on the unity in Christ searched by organic union and conciliar fellowship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an institution of Christ as a gift from the Lord."
Holy Communion or Eucharist is an institution of Christ as a gift from the Lord.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dynamic model that has given due consideration to the changing cultural condition to the experience to previous decades, therefore has given shape of what is known by this model of visible unity."

Organic union is a dynamic model that has given due consideration to the changing cultural condition to the experience to previous decades, therefore has given shape of what is known by this model of visible unity.
fib: ______ is a composition of God's image bearers.
church
The church is a composition of God's image bearers.
______ is a new model of unity that has shown itself in the ecumenical scene especially from the experience of theologians and churches in Latin America.
Unity as solidarity
Unity as solidarity is a new model of unity that has shown itself in the ecumenical scene especially from the experience of theologians and churches in Latin America.
______ is the point of unity for the church because in him all things hold together (Col. 1:17).
Christ
Christ is the point of unity for the church because in him all things hold together (Col. 1:17).
______ is a person's disposition towards the precepts of God which controls his/her commitment and overall attitude.
Spirituality
Spirituality is a person's disposition towards the precepts of God which controls his/her commitment and overall attitude.
______ is a model built up in the mid 1970s during the revival of the World Confessional Families or Christian World Communions.
Reconciled diversity
Reconciled diversity is a model built up in the mid 1970s during the revival of the World Confessional Families or Christian World Communions.
______ is the confessional standards that we subscribe to, and the pastoral is the active guidance of the leadership in enriching people's lives.
theological
The theological is the confessional standards that we subscribe to, and the pastoral is the active guidance of the leadership in enriching people's lives.
______ is the reference point for all believers and the rule of faith.
Scripture
Scripture is the reference point for all believers and the rule of faith.
______ are the Church Union Movement in Nigeria (CUMN), United Gospel Churches Association of Nigeria (UGCAN) and the Pentecostal Fellowship of Nigeria (PFN).
Among these bodies
Among these bodies are the Church Union Movement in Nigeria (CUMN), United Gospel Churches Association of Nigeria (UGCAN) and the Pentecostal Fellowship of Nigeria (PFN).
______ is one of the major ecumenical bloc of CAN in Nigeria, which is the Christian Council of Nigeria (CCN).
Included in this review
Included in this review is one of the major ecumenical bloc of CAN in Nigeria, which is the Christian Council of Nigeria (CCN).
______ is the last of the many theophanies that have taken place before in the creation, and this divine self- emptying is the essential character of God.
incarnation of Christ
The incarnation of Christ is the last of the many theophanies that have taken place before in the creation, and this divine self- emptying is the essential character of God.
______ is the assembly, which meets at intervals of approximately six years at various locations throughout the world.
controlling body of the WCC
The controlling body of the WCC is the assembly, which meets at intervals of approximately six years at various locations throughout the world.
______ is a gracious act of God toward the sinner who has put faith in Christ rather than by the sinner's righteous acts.
Justification
Justification is a gracious act of God toward the sinner who has put faith in Christ rather than by the sinner's righteous acts.
